retrieval_method: fetch_page tool, parsed page/PDF excerpts; not raw HTTP byte snapshots
scope: Exact observation scopes are recorded per source. Excerpt reachability is not verification of all links, datasets, scientific hypotheses, or portal acceptance.

sources.claim: The initial test faults are expert-mapped and absent from the public catalogue. Predictions target faults, not confirmed geothermal vents. The metric is distance-weighted Tversky; the file is a single float32 GeoTIFF in [0,1] on the supplied grid.
sources.observed_excerpt: For this competition, you will submit a GeoTIFF file containing your predictions for all faults in the region.
sources.caveat: The public format describes null/NaN outside bounds. Our zero-outside policy is not proof of organizer upload acceptance.

sources.claim: Faults involve measurable displacement; gravity/magnetic anomalies and surface lineaments are evidence to interpret, not sufficient proof of a fault.
sources.observed_excerpt: A geological fault is a fracture or discontinuity in Earth’s crust where two blocks of rock have undergone measurable displacement, whether vertical, horizontal, or a combination of both.
sources.caveat: The proposed image transforms are our untested hypotheses, not endorsed or validated by this page.

sources.claim: Registration, weekly limits, one final selection across both rounds, reproducible code assets/documentation, and disclosure of generative-AI use are required.
sources.observed_excerpt: You can make multiple submissions, subject to the limits specified on the competition website (three submissions per week).
sources.caveat: This public rule is not the authenticated account’s remaining quota, eligibility determination, or an organizer receipt.

sources.claim: The official data tab requires authentication; no authenticated official data was downloaded in this audit.
sources.caveat: Hash-verified GitHub mirrors are not independent organizer authentication. Never request credentials in chat.

sources.claim: Magnetics, radiometrics, flight-line data and coordinated lidar products are described. Variable terrain clearance and different acquisition specifications are documented confounders.
sources.observed_excerpt: variable terrain clearance should be considered when modeling and interpreting these data.
sources.caveat: CC0 metadata was observed. Native grid/DEM bytes and complete coverage were not obtained from USGS here; metadata access is not data obtainability.

sources.claim: The INGENIOUS compilation lists temperature probes, earthquakes, geodetics, geophysics, MT and well/spring chemistry. The page states attribution and fitness-for-use limitations.
sources.observed_excerpt: These datasets may be redistributed with attribution
sources.caveat: Only the resource-listing chunk was read in this audit. A listed resource is not verification of its downloaded bytes or suitability.

sources.claim: The report discusses offset pairs of magnetic rock bodies and concealed faults, motivating the marker-translation hypothesis.
sources.observed_excerpt: positions, shapes, and offset histories of various fault segments concealed beneath water or young alluvium.
sources.caveat: This Bay Area study motivates a mechanism; it does not validate automated transfer to the GeoDAWN region or predict competition performance.

sources.claim: Basement-offset interpretations can indicate faults that do not reach the present surface and may be inactive.
sources.observed_excerpt: they are interpreted to be inactive faults, older than the alluvial basin fill.
sources.caveat: This is an explicit falsification risk for any basement-edge detector of surface faults, not support for interpreting every edge as an active geothermal conduit.

sources.claim: The reference solution supports both GPU and CPU-only environments.
sources.observed_excerpt: Training is much faster on a GPU, so use one if you have it.
sources.caveat: A GPU is not an absolute training prerequisite. The owner-quoted downloader/prepare scripts are not present in this repository.

sources.claim: The page labels the H33-2-B2 result as a projection/model, not a score, and the listed note contains UNSCORED.
sources.observed_excerpt: projected live DTI 0.2747 (a MODEL, not a score).
sources.caveat: This does not disprove that the owner subsequently obtained 0.2778; no corresponding submission-page receipt is available here, so that supplied result remains OWNER-REPORTED.
